name: zzCE2_fire_ramp

tests.name: both fire knobs can be read back before anything is changed
both fire knobs this job found were put back
every rung set the material and gain it asked for

detail.note: wl.Look.FireMaterial is recorded in this tree as having refused a value once, so both knobs are asserted rather than assumed.

tests.name: every rung photographed several distinct frames

detail.note: the flame animates, so identical frames would mean the capture, not the fire, is frozen.

tests.name: the rungs do not all answer the same, so the metric can tell them apart

detail.note: THE GUARD THE FIRST RUN LACKED. Five configurations reading 98.61 to two decimals is a saturated instrument, and it passed the qualifying clause on exactly that.

tests.name: the shaped material can reach the approved plume's height while keeping its colour

detail.note: THE QUESTION THE SOURCE LEFT OPEN -- M_WL_Fire 'may yet be the right base once it can reach that brightness without losing its colour'. If no rung qualifies, the answer is that gain alone cannot get there and the material itself needs work, which is a far more useful result than another side-by-side.
